tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards, panels and lists.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, lists, inputs, sidebar and topbar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus and popovers that float above content.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Neutral fill: segmented control track, active sidebar item, icon tiles, neutral badges, progress track, kbd.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state on rows, ghost buttons, sidebar items; skeletons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: borders on cards, lists, topbar and sidebar, and dividers. Decorative.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: inputs, checkbox, radio and the off switch track. At least 3:1 against `canvas`, `surface` and `fill`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, inactive navigation, labels - on every surface (at least 5.8:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, metadata - only on `canvas`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (not on `fill`).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Text in disabled controls only (exempt from contrast requirements).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The only 'accent': primary button, checked checkbox and radio, on switch, progress. Black in light mode, white in dark mode.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on `primary` fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px offset. Meets 3:1 everywhere.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success as text or icon on `canvas`, `surface` and `success-soft`. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind `success`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning as text or icon on `canvas`, `surface` and `warning-soft`. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind `warning`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive items as text on every surface and on `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind `danger`.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Fill for destructive buttons - always with `on-danger`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on `danger-solid` (4.8:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Solid dimming behind dialogs, drawers and the command palette. Never blur.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Manrope at 800 with tight tracking. Never below 700 for headings.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and landing pages. One per page.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body text is 500 - never thin. 14px is the UI default.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Your data syncs automatically across your devices.
styles.usage: Longer text and landing page copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, small buttons, sidebar items.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and tight text; kbd padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between icon and label; between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding in inputs and rows; between label and input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding in cards and lists; between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding in cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups; page margin on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections; page margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above page titles and large sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section spacing on landing pages.

radius.note: Sharp, small corners. Pills only for badges, switch, avatars and radios.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, kbd, icon tiles, selected segment.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, sidebar items, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Lists, tables, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, switch, avatars and radios only.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and the selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, toasts and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Command palette and drawer - the largest floating layers.

size.note: Compact controls - the text fills the control, not the air.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons in rows, cards and the topbar.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, search field.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary action in forms and on mobile.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Minimum height of list rows.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width.

zIndex.note: Fixed layering so menus, dialogs and toasts never end up behind each other.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, context menus, popovers.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Scrim, dialogs, drawer and command palette.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: The toast stack - always on top, even above dialogs.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

motion.note: Quick and calm. Only opacity and transform move, nothing bounces, and things leave faster than they arrive.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and color changes on controls; everything that closes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, toasts and accordions opening; the drawer closing.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the drawer and the command palette opening; the theme crossfade.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that appears or responds to the pointer.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Everything that leaves.
